text:
alex: Heads-up — console change: adding `Policy impact` column to per-route dashboard that shows routing decisions + quota buckets. This depends on a new SDK header shape (route-meta v2). Need a quick run-through on SDK break risk and rollout plan.

maria: Nice. Do you have the header spec? thinking about telemetry mapping as well.

alex: Spec draft here: https://redwoodinternal/docs/route-meta-v2 (WIP). Example header we want from SDKs:

```
X-Route-Meta: version=2;policy=weighted;priority=gold;quota_bucket=team-alpha
```

We currently get sparse route tags from clients. v2 unifies priority+quota fields.

katie: Is this additive or will it replace v1? If we replace it'll be a breaking change for older SDKs.

alex: Plan is additive for now: servers accept both, console prefers v2 if present. But console tiles + attribution UX rely on v2 fields being present to surface the new column.

joel: From SDK side: Python/TS/Go can emit v2 easily, but concern is older customers pinned to older SDK versions. We should do an opt-in header flag first (SDK config), then a short canary.

sam: +1. Suggest rollout steps: 1) add v2 behind feature flag in SDKs, 2) console reads v2 when available and shows a small "Showing beta route metadata" banner, 3) telemetry fallback to v1 mapping for attribution, 4) enable flag for internal canary orgs, 5) broader opt-in, then GA.

katie: Agree. Also we need to handle sampling: don't want large customers sending full detailed route-meta at 100% by default. Add sampling hint in header?

maria: Good point. Maybe a separate header: `X-Route-Meta-Sample: 0.01` or embed sample= in header. We'll need console displays to annotate sampled rows.

joel: Implementation note for SDKs: we'll add a `routeMeta` optional param in constructor and a `routeMetaOptIn` flag. Example TS API: `new RedwoodClient({ key, routeMeta: { priority: 'gold', quotaBucket: 'team-alpha' }, routeMetaOptIn: true })`.

alex: Can we make the opt-in default=false? We want minimal accidental rollouts.

joel: Default=false. We'll add telemetry event on opt-in to track adoption.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout of console change to staging started (staging-console-3) — 2 nodes. Link: https://deploys.redwood/staging/console/3

sam: Action items: alex to update console PR to prefer v2 + add UX banner; joel to add opt-in flag + sampling header in SDKs; maria to update telemetry mapping; katie to draft customer comms note about opt-in path.

alex: I'll open PRs today and tag everyone. Want a follow-up sync tomorrow 10am.

katie: lgtm. If we see any mismatch in attribution numbers we should roll the console tile back quickly. :thumbsup:

joel: Will add unit tests and a smoke test that verifies console reads both header shapes.

maria: I'll add telemetry dashboards for sampled vs unsampled counts so we can monitor.

alex: thanks — tagging @here for visibility.
